text: Free laptops, miracle cures, urgent deadlines. Our family groups are full of forwards. Which ones are true?
Paste a message. Claude Opus 5.5 pulls out each claim and checks it live, against official sources and fact-checkers.
One claim true, one outdated, one false. Each with evidence you can open.
Images work too. This real viral poster? False.
It lives in Telegram too. Forward a message, or just speak. It replies in your language, and reads the answer aloud.
No trusted source? Code withdraws the verdict.
Twenty-four out of twenty-four on our test set. Forward Check. Check before you forward.
